cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(gfxlab LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/W4>
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/permissive->
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/utf-8>
        # /wd4211: nvcc's generated *.cudafe1.stub.c files redeclare
        # kernels as static, which MSVC reports under /W4. That code is
        # generated by the CUDA compiler, not written here
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=/W4,/utf-8,/wd4211>
    )
endif()

if(WIN32)
    add_compile_definitions(
        WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
        NOMINMAX UNICODE
        _UNICODE
    )
endif()

# Optional backend detection
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(GfxBackends)
include(GfxShaders)

add_subdirectory(src/core)

# The window layer and the app are Windows-only. The core library and the
# tests are portable and are built everywhere
if(WIN32)
    add_subdirectory(src/platform)

    if(GFX_HAVE_OPENGL)
        add_subdirectory(src/renderer/opengl)
    endif()

    if(GFX_HAVE_VULKAN)
        add_subdirectory(src/renderer/vulkan)
    endif()

    if(GFX_HAVE_CUDA)
        add_subdirectory(src/renderer/cuda)
    endif()

    add_subdirectory(src/renderer)
    add_subdirectory(src/app)
endif()

enable_testing()
add_subdirectory(tests)
